message.content:
B. At night in a rural area, you would expect minimal tropospheric ozone formation.

Reason: ozone formation is photochemical and needs sunlight; rural areas have low anthropogenic VOCs and NOx, so nighttime ozone production is minimal, and nitrogen oxide does not rapidly accumulate.

Palindromes: level, radar, civic, kayak, rotor, refer, madam, tenet, reviver, deified.
